Nina (AE): Heads upSablePoint sent an RFI. They need capability matrix, security answers (HSM/KMS), and a 30-day POC quote.

Ravi (SE): I can create the matrix + POC runbook. Do they require on-prem HSM or will Private VPC with customer KMS be enough?

Tessa (Security): They specified FIPS HSM and key custody controls. I'll draft Q12 text: support for AWS/GCP/Azure KMS + PKCS#11 HSMs, audit logs exportable.

Connor (Finance Bot): Quick placeholders: POC dev bundle $4,500 (30d, single 16GB GPU). Indicative committed Dedicated start $17,500/mo per GPU (final quote after region/commit).

Ravi (SE): Uploading capability_matrix_sablepoint_v1.csv and poc_checklist_sablepoint_v1.md now. Bootstrap snippet in runbook covers dedicated provisioning.

Nina (AE): Perfect. I'll assemble RFI packet and ask for sign-off by 2pm PT. Please flag any gaps asap.

Tessa (Security): If legal delays SOC2 redaction, we'll supply a gated link with ETA.

Ravi (SE): Noted. Will review matrix and ping for missing features.

Nina (AE): Thanks team  aiming to send initial packet tomorrow morning.
